# State & Data shows the todo list every evaluator compares

## Context

Every evaluator of a UI platform looks for the todo list, because every other platform has one. Neo's is `examples/todoList/version2`: last changed in September 2024, no catalog record. #21140's target renews it for State & Data, and the band's epic #21358 counts it among its nine renewals. No leaf was filed.

## The Problem

The band's read ([its rows](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980292611)): "Three 'Todo Item N' in 300 px on a white page. Adding works. The three boxes open unchecked though the first record is `done`: the list's `checkedField` is `checked`, the model's field is `done`." So the example a stranger compares first is small, unstyled and opens on a wrong state.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/todoList/version2`: the folder to rebuild in place; its model is `TodoListModel.mjs`.
- The mismatch between the list's `checkedField` and the model's field is in the example, not in the engine.
- `examples/todoList/version1` is the same list in raw vdom from 2019 and gets no record.

## The Fix

Rebuild the example in place as the todo list an evaluator expects: add an item, check it off, filter by all, open and done, a count of what is left, and the list kept in the browser's storage across a reload. The list binds a store of records. It opens on a few believable items with one already done, drawn as done.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Add, check off, filter and the count work, by pointer and by keyboard.
- [ ] A record that is done opens checked.
- [ ] The list survives a reload from the browser's storage, and one control clears it.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, in every theme its sibling examples offer.
- [ ] A record in State & Data with a caption in the visitor's words and a cover from its first frame (through `neomjs/pages`).
- [ ] The look: the first frame and the filtered frame, both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

A second todo variant, a server, drag to reorder (Lists & Galleries shows that). A record for `todoList/version1`.

## Avoided Traps

- **A showcase instead of the reference.** Its value is that a stranger can compare it line by line with the todo list they know; it stays small and plain in its code.
